owner_and_protocol: Single persistent owner runs tusb_rhport_init and bounded tud_task_ext; all class API calls/callback work obey this ownership. Task default in esp_tinyusb isCPU1/priority5; choose affinity intentionally.
Default tud_task eventcap16 followed by immediate loop does not guarantee blocking under event flood. Use a real bounded work quantum/block and finite command work.
DATA andCTRL separate bounded lanes/endpoints. Keep BLEahead of debugCDC; absentUSBhost must not block BLE/acquisition.
Preserve encoder ASCII bytes, frameCRC and immutable identity. Bulk packet/read boundaries are not frame boundaries.
tud_vendor_n_write returns acceptedbytecount. Stock vendor callback discards xfer_result_t and only reports bytes; do not label asPCreceipt or unconditionallysuccessfulbuscompletion.
FIFO-disabled write still memcpys into persistent endpointbuffer. Do not free or reuse a liveDMA buffer after a timeout.
Battery-powered board needs actualVBUSsense for self-powered attach/detach contract; cannot invent hardwaremonitor or claim backpower isolation.
